title: Animation: the controller-connected banner slides in/out
description: The 'Controller connected' banner (and its dismiss button) used to pop in/out with a bare SwiftUI if-condition and no transition. Added .transition(.move(edge:.top).combined(with:.opacity)) on the banner and wrapped both real triggers (ControllerObserver.refresh(), fired on real connect/disconnect notifications - and the banner's own dismiss button) in withAnimation so the transition actually fires both ways, not just one.
